Positions the team is recruiting for. Empty = open to all positions. Shown on the public team page when open for new players.
Link to follow if the team is full (e.g. waiting-list form). Filling this shows a waiting-list button on the public website and marks the team as full there.

Mixed teams: open for new boys. Only used when "Open for players" is on.
Mixed teams: open for new girls. Only used when "Open for players" is on.
